{{Quote|In the name of the First Huntsman, by the Stone of Chianar, I pronounce you brethren of the order.|Chanya Medaal|<ref name="TOR:TDP">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Devouring Plague|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
